headline: Wednesday at the lake: warm and mostly dry with highs near 91°F
lede: Wednesday, September 30 brings classic late-September Branson weather — warm with a high near 91°F, mostly cloudy skies, and very low rain chance. Perfect for a full day on the water, a show, or exploring the Strip. Lake levels stable; light winds.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Day
featured.why: Warm water, stable levels around 911–912 ft, and light winds make this an ideal midweek lake day for first-timers. Morning bite for bass and crappie before afternoon shows.

plan.title: Morning fishing bite
plan.detail: Bass and crappie active near shorelines and points on Table Rock. Taneycomo trout strong during generation periods. Check current USACE data.

plan.title: Lake or Strip exploration
plan.detail: Boat, swim, or hike at Table Rock State Park. Alternatively, stroll the Strip for shopping and people-watching in warm weather.
